## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Synchronously blocking CPU execution on MTLCommandBuffer waitUntilCompleted() prevents overlapping CPU dispatch with GPU execution, causing up to 25% throughput degradation on small models. (high confidence) — https://developer.apple.com/documentation/metal/gpu_compilation/building_a_shader_library_offline · keywords: Metal Pipeline State Caching and Kernel Dispatch Bubbles · also: https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/blob/master/ggml/src/ggml-metal.metal

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Runtime compilation of Metal compute shaders creates hitches during initial token generation; caching compiled pipeline states in an MTLBinaryArchive eliminates shader compilation latency. (high confidence) — https://developer.apple.com/documentation/metal/gpu_compilation/building_a_shader_library_offline · keywords: Metal Pipeline State Caching and Kernel Dispatch Bubbles · also: https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/blob/master/ggml/src/ggml-metal.metal
